integrity: Proof is self-contained; attached finite high-precision checks corroborate but cannot establish infinite quantifiers. Prior-art comparisons carry the stated residual coverage risks.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula covers one rank-one fidelity halfspace intersected with the trace-one positive-semidefinite body, over real symmetric or complex Hermitian finite matrices; it does not solve multi-observable sections, optimal ellipsoid constants, or the degenerate zero-width case. Independent external validation has not been performed.
title: Exact Minkowski symmetry of a rank-one fidelity cap in the semidefinite trace-one body
